answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with stake-bound identity: each agent posts a single non-transferable bond under its own key, so bonded agents nicknamed willow, yarrow, and juniper each control exactly one attestation. Weight grows quadratically with the bond, meaning ten fake identities demand a hundred times the deposit. A lie slashes the entire bond, so an attacker must fund every clone up front and loses it all on the first disproven vote — a hundred-vote takeover costs far more than honest work.
